claims.text: Every visit: age-appropriate exam, with an infant totally unclothed and older children undressed and suitably draped.
claims.quote: At each visit, age-appropriate physical examination is essential, with infant totally unclothed and older children undressed and suitably draped.

claims.text: General observations: assess alertness; assess for congenital anomalies and note any dysmorphic features.
claims.quote: General observations – Assess alertness. – Assess for congenital anomalies and note any dysmorphic features.
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Measure and plot on appropriate WHO Growth Chart: recumbent length; weight; head circumference; weight-for-length.
claims.quote: Measure and plot on appropriate WHO Growth Chart – Recumbent length – Weight – Head circumference – Weight-for-length
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Skin: inspect for rashes or jaundice; assess hydration.
claims.quote: Skin – Inspect for rashes or jaundice. – Assess hydration.
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Head: observe shape (sutures, molding), size, and fontanels; note evidence of birth trauma.
claims.quote: Head – Observe shape (sutures, molding), size, and fontanels. – Note evidence of birth trauma.
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Eyes: inspect eyes and eyelids; examine pupils for opacification and red reflexes; assess visual acuity using fixate and follow response.
claims.quote: Eyes – Inspect eyes and eyelids. – Examine pupils for opacification and red reflexes. – Assess visual acuity using fixate and follow response.
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Heart: auscult for murmurs; palpate femoral pulses and compare against upper extremity pulses.
claims.quote: Heart – Auscult for murmurs. – Palpate femoral pulses and compare against upper extremity pulses.
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Abdomen: inspect umbilical cord and umbilicus; palpate for masses.
claims.quote: Abdomen – Inspect umbilical cord and umbilicus. – Palpate for masses.
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Genitourinary: palpate testes in male newborn; inspect external female genitalia.
claims.quote: Genitourinary – Palpate testes in male newborn. – Inspect external female genitalia.
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Musculoskeletal: perform Ortolani and Barlow maneuvers; examine the spine and back for deformities, sinus tracts, dimples, hair tufts.
claims.quote: Musculoskeletal – Perform Ortolani and Barlow maneuvers. – Examine the spine and back for deformities, sinus tracts, dimples, hair tufts.
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Neurologic: note posture, tone, activity level, symmetry of movement, neonatal reflexes and state regulation (alertness, orientation, and regulatory capacity).
claims.quote: Neurologic – Note posture, tone, activity level, symmetry of movement, neonatal reflexes and state regulation (alertness, orientation, and regulatory capacity).
claims.locator: First week visit (3 to 5 days), Health Supervision: Physical Examination
